elements.quote: The Delta variant ... was first reported in October 2020 and has spread to more than 180 countries globally [1]. Concerns were raised about how well the currently available vaccines protect against this variant.
elements.reason: The introduction describes the current state of knowledge (Delta variant spread, existing living review since January 2021) and the uncertainty about vaccine protection against Delta.

elements.quote: Concerns were raised about how well the currently available vaccines protect against this variant. Since January 2021, the Robert Koch Institute (RKI) ... is performing a living systematic review ... Here we present results on the effectiveness and the duration of protection provided by the EU-licensed COVID-19 vaccines in respect to the Delta variant.
elements.reason: The need for the review is explained by the public health concern regarding vaccine protection against the newly dominant Delta variant.

elements.quote: second interim results of a living systematic review and meta-analysis ... (PROSPERO registration: CRD42020208935) [2].
elements.reason: The manuscript identifies itself as the second interim update of an existing living systematic review and cites the previous review [2] with PROSPERO registration.

The review evaluates vaccine effectiveness, not a complex intervention or delivery context, so a logic model is not required.

elements.quote: Here we present results on the effectiveness and the duration of protection provided by the EU-licensed COVID-19 vaccines in respect to the Delta variant.
